service.description: ageLANServer for Age of Empires II/III: Definitive Edition and Age of Mythology: Retold: HTTPS API (TCP 443) and LAN announcements (UDP 31978, multicast 239.31.97.8; clients receive them too). The Battle Server picks random ports unless they are pinned in its config; pinned ports need adding here. TCP 443 is also LanCache's HTTPS port, so ageLANServer and LanCache cannot run on the same host.
